description:
Heya Pals,

Sit back and relax as we go through the motions of the ocean in painting a pixel parallax beach scene! I thought it would be nice to try out something super chill to fit between the more technical content I've been uploading recently. Let me know what you think!

You can grab the Indie Tales Parallax asset featuring this and other works from the channel at https://uppon-hill.itch.io/indie-tales-parallax :)

Chapters:

0:00 - Introduction
0:47 - Blocking In Shapes
3:39 - Separating Layers
4:20 - (nice) Clouds
7:39 - Beach and Ocean
10:02 - Marram Grass Tufts
12:48 - Middleground Grass
16:19 - First Test in Unity
17:16 - Beach Rocks
18:56 - Foreground Terrain
23:26 - Seagulls
25:14 - Silhouette Foreground
26:34 - Final Result

----

This video features clips from my stream. Catch it live: Mon, Tues, Thurs and Fri 1-6pm AEST.

Twitch: http://twitch.tv/adamcyounis
Twitter: http://twitter.com/adamcyounis
Discord: https://discord.gg/9WkRG7s
Become a Patron at https://www.patreon.com/adamcyounis

Check out my game Insignia at http://uppon-hill.itch.io/insignia

Later, pals!
